To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of the combination of sodium hypochlorite and bactericide is the best treatment to remove 100% of biofilms in paper manufacturing process.

The use of the combination of hypochlorite of sodium with bactericide is the adequate treatment to have a removal of biofilms of 100% and to reduce economic losses of the company in 100%, besides a better microbiological quality of the paper.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the effect of the presence of biofilms in the paper manufacturing process.
the optimization of the paper making process in order to eliminate the biofilms formation in the pipes of the Ecuadorian company Sancela del Lasso, Cotopaxi Province.
the optimization of paper manufacturing process to eliminate biofilm formation in the pipes of the company Familia Sancelas del Ecuador S.A, located in the Lasso sector, Cotopaxi province.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of the combination of sodium hypochlorite and bactericide in the treatment of the water used in the paper manufacturing process is the most efficient way to prevent the formation of biofilms and the consequent contamination of paper.

this study has shown that the use of a combination between a oxidant (hypochlorite of sodium) and a preservative (bactericide) in a concentration of 0.1% of hypochlorite and 0.1ml/liter of bactericide in the paper making process of Familia Sancelo del Ecuador S.A., has allowed the complete removal of biofilms, and therefore, a significant improvement in the microbiological quality of the paper.

the treatment of the water used in the paper manufacturing process with a combination of hypochlorite and a bactericide, allows to eliminate the biofilm formation in the pipes of the paper manufacturing process, thus reducing the rejection of paper due to the presence of this defect, which allows the company to reduce economic losses and also improves microbiological quality of the paper.
